info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Employee Data Management API
info.description: The Employee Data Management API facilitates the efficient handling of employee-related information within the banking sector. This API allows organizations to submit new employee data, ensuring that critical HR processes are streamlined and accurate. Typical consumers of this API include HR systems and payroll processing applications, which rely on real-time employee information to operate effectively. It empowers businesses to maintain an up-to-date employee database, enhancing overall workforce management and compliance.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new employee records in the human resource management system. Provide the necessary details in the request body to add an employee to the database.

requestBody.description: A JSON object representing the employee data to be managed. This includes various attributes such as name, position, and contact information that will be used to create or update employee records.

201.description: Resource created successfully, representing the new employee data.
